statements.text: Enable native Forgejo local-only cycle registration and exact local validation before separately reviewed manual delivery.
Local completion performs no network activity and confers no push, pull-request, merge, release, deployment or publication authority.
Use full provider/origin/repository identities in versioned manifest and receipt schema 2, with an exact typed expected-target CLI interface.
Use explicitly local-only native Cycle Record schema 6 and reject unsupported versions or modes before mutation.
Preserve existing GitHub schema 1/5 identities, digests, serialized shapes and delivery behavior, including legacy local intent.
Bind committed authority, profile, plan, native checkout, exact destinations, credential selection and fetched comparison base to fresh launch approval and resume validation.
Use explicitly selected canonical HTTPS and native macOS Keychain lookup for controlled read-only Git fetch; account selection is not API principal proof.
Reject unsafe destinations, redirects, rewrites, ambient credentials, configuration injection and interactive fallback without leaking secrets.
Complete only exact validated source and gate evidence, retain ordered commit and tree identity, and support bounded idempotency after pointer removal.
Preserve unpublished local work and failed evidence; local completion cannot authorize removal or fabricate remote preservation.
Keep reviewed manual delivery as a separate explicit Git operation without an automatic publication command in this slice.
Keep the complete remote-automation feature and unresolved safety contracts blocked, preserving earlier failed qualification evidence.
Use the existing lifecycle bounded context and owners with critical risk, Python and Security modules; add no parallel state engine or dependency.
Keep private consumer names, endpoints, accounts, machine paths, credentials and raw evidence outside public support artifacts.
Deliver the public support source through the existing explicit-account GitHub draft-PR path with exact publication checks and digest-bound launch approval.
Separate source-cycle Release/Deploy/Operate non-applicability from required post-merge managed installation and bounded operation before consumer use.
Verify compatibility, controlled transport, stale-authority rejection, zero-network completion and unpublished-work preservation with meaningful acceptance evidence.
Treat specification readiness, actual preflight, implementation, managed installation and real consumer qualification as separate proofs.
Review existing bounded-context README and CHANGELOG and update durable truth and the completion entry through the registered source cycle.
Limit eventual managed installation to the merged support revision on the current computer and do not alter consumer deployment or remote server protection.
